zh.name: UWBeacon：水下厘米级定位
zh.question: 如何在低能见度和强环境光干扰的水下环境中实现高精度定位？
zh.method: 使用 LED 信标与相机接收器，并以不同颜色和偏振角的偏振光抑制背景干扰。

en.name: UWBeacon: Centimeter-Level Underwater Positioning
en.question: How can accurate positioning work underwater amid poor visibility and strong ambient-light interference?
en.method: LED beacons and a camera receiver use polarized lights of different colors and angles to suppress background interference.

zh.name: AquaLink：水下光学相机通信
zh.question: 如何在动态、带宽受限的水下环境中实现可靠通信，而不依赖专用收发硬件？
zh.method: 以普通手机和平板进行二维码光学相机通信，结合蓝绿双色编码、LDPC 纠错和环境自适应。

en.name: AquaLink: Underwater Optical Camera Communication
en.question: How can reliable communication work in dynamic, bandwidth-limited underwater settings without specialized transceivers?
en.method: QR-code optical camera communication on commodity phones and tablets combines blue-green encoding, LDPC error correction, and environmental adaptation.

zh.name: 工业物联网自适应任务卸载
zh.question: 如何让工业物联网中的延迟敏感任务更快适应变化，同时减少标注数据与训练开销？
zh.method: 半监督储备池计算框架固定动态储备层、仅训练读出层，并利用未标注数据。

en.name: Adaptive Task Offloading for Industrial IoT
en.question: How can latency-sensitive Industrial IoT tasks adapt quickly while reducing labeled-data and training costs?
en.method: A semi-supervised reservoir-computing framework keeps a dynamic reservoir fixed, trains only the readout layer, and uses unlabeled data.

zh.name: 多潜器协同护航
zh.question: 如何让多台自主水下航行器在海流等因素下协同护航载人潜器？
zh.method: 基于水下物联网的软件定义网络协同通信，并以人工流场势场算法规划多潜器路径。

en.name: Cooperative Escort by Multiple Submersibles
en.question: How can multiple autonomous underwater vehicles coordinate to escort a crewed submersible amid ocean currents?
en.method: Software-defined networking for underwater IoV supports coordination, while an artificial-flow potential-field algorithm plans multi-submersible paths.
